reports.title: Xenon Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update

desk.headline: Clinical-stage: net loss widens to $110.4m as R&D rises; azetukalner filed with FDA, cash of $1.15bn funds operations into 2029
results: No revenue in the quarter (none a year earlier either). Net loss grew to $110.4m from $90.9m, but the loss per share eased to $1.11 from $1.15 because there are more shares.
R&D rose 24% to $95.6m, mainly Phase 3 depression and bipolar studies plus manufacturing to prepare for a possible azetukalner launch; G&A rose 27% to $24.4m.
Cash and investments reached $1.15bn at 30 Sep, up from $586.0m at end-2025; higher interest income lifted other income to $11.5m.
The FDA application (NDA) for azetukalner in focal seizures was submitted in September; the X-NOVA2 depression study finished enrolling about 360 patients.
In September the company voluntarily paused new patient enrollment in its Phase 3 depression and bipolar studies; patients already enrolled continue.

guidance.summary: No financial guidance, as usual for a clinical-stage biotech. The company says cash should fund operations into 2029 and set out pipeline timelines, including X-NOVA2 depression results now expected in December 2026.

items.metric: X-FIRST Phase 3b/4 study start (first add-on epilepsy drug)
Phase 2 acute pain studies start (XEN1701, XEN1120)

watch: X-NOVA2 depression topline results, now due in December 2026, and the status of the paused depression/bipolar enrollment.
The FDA's response to the azetukalner focal-seizure NDA submitted in September.
New epilepsy data at the American Epilepsy Society meeting (4–8 Dec 2026).
